plan: Drive: from Lower Post, about 109 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 59.62974, -127.11559, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 5.2 km S, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 127 m, about 117 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 100 m SE of the spot at 514 m (59.58518, -127.14581). Water: Rabbit River 50 m NW (estimate).
Hunt: ducks, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-51, Region 7B. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2024-12-12, closures 2026-10-16.

plan: Drive: from Lower Post, about 112 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 59.62313, -127.07683, where the truck road ends (Hwy 97 (Alaska Hwy)); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
